title: 🤝 Multiple Community & Social Service Jobs in Pinal County, AZ - NewsBreak
text:
23 hours ago Pinal County is seeing steady growth in community and social service roles, especially in Sacaton and Florence. These openings are great for folks who care about helping others and want to make a difference close to home.
Counselor – Behavioral Health Services (HHK) Employer: Gila River Health Care
Location: Sacaton, AZ
Type: Full-time
Provide counseling and behavioral health support for patients dealing with mental health, substance use, or trauma. This role works closely with a clinical team and requires a Master’s degree and Arizona licensure (LPC, LCSW, LMFT, or LIAC) .
Adult Treatment Court Case Manager Employer: Gila River Indian Community
Location: Sacaton, AZ
Type: Full-time
Salary: $51,874 – $77,874 per year
Work with the Adult Drug Court program to guide participants through treatment and recovery. Ideal for someone with a Bachelor’s in Social Work or related field and experience in case management. Apply by April 8, 2026.
Volunteer Program Coordinator (Part-time) Employer: Pinal County
Location: Florence, AZ
Type: Part-time
Help run the county’s volunteer and animal enrichment programs. You’ll recruit and train volunteers, organize community outreach, and support shelter animals. Great fit for someone with 3+ years of animal care experience and strong people skills.
